📖 How to use

  1. Paste your draft into the box.
  2. Weasel words — "very", "just", "literally", "synergy" and 90+ more — are highlighted in your text.
  3. Delete or replace the highlighted words to make every sentence stronger.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are weasel words?

Words that drain strength from a sentence without adding meaning: "very", "really", "just", "basically", "literally", plus hedges like "sort of" and corporate filler like "synergy" and "leverage".

How many words does it check?

The built-in bank holds 95+ single words and phrases, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.

Should I delete every highlighted word?

Most, but not all — context matters. "I think" can be honest hedging; "very unique" is never right. Use highlights as an editing prompt.
